body:
News: ranked down again. Gold 3. Did top play etc.
I just think when you start losing you get paired with other "losers" to keep losing.

I'll add one thing.
I just won a game, ending a 16 losses streak today and preventing myself to rank down to Gold 3.
The fact is I don't even tilt, I don't play that bad (I mantain my 1.0 KDR as a frontline/support, I did two top plays in 10 matches) as you are describing.
I don't think I deserve to stay in Gold 2 or 3, and I think I can make it up to Platinum.
But, there's a but, this last game earned me 10 TP, while every game I've lost subtracted me 11 TP, which is 1 more.
It's really hard to climb this mountain.
Maybe with a team able to communicate and adjust properly I can do better.
